title: Momo Rain

outfit_card.silhouette: A-line, knee-length tiered dress in lemon-yellow sheer organza with a ruffled, asymmetrical overskirt, a fitted bodice and voluminous hood, creating a playful, layered, and roomy outline.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: An integrated lemon-yellow hood with sculpted cat ears, lined in soft tulle, with a red bow at the neckline and frosted lace trim.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A fitted yellow bodice with a rounded neckline, sheer organza overlay, white lace trim, a large red ribbon bow, gold screen-printed cloud motifs, and long puff sleeves with ruffled cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A pleated lemon-yellow dress with tiered white lace petticoats and a sky-blue hem, paired with white socks, fluffy ankle cuffs, and tan Mary Jane shoes.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A small, floating rain-cloud accessory, scattered raindrop and paw-print motifs, a tiny cat companion, and a folded umbrella charm.
